tram_announcer.name: tram announcer
tram_announcer.description: A recorded voice from a speaker grille.

talk: The announcer is a recording. It carries on regardless.

tram_window.name: tram window
tram_window.description: Through the scratched plexiglass, Black Mesa slides past.

robot_arm.name: robotic arm
robot_arm.appearance: A yellow robotic arm swings a pallet past the tram.

gman_glimpse.name: man in a blue suit
gman_glimpse.description: He's gone before you can get a proper look. You feel, unreasonably, that he was looking at you.

platform_guard.name: Officer #bm_surname#
platform_guard.description: A cheerful guard in a blue shirt who seems to know who you are.

do: "Morning, Mr. Freeman. They're waiting for you upstairs in the test lab. Better hurry."

lobby_guard.name: Officer #bm_surname#
lobby_guard.appearance: {self.Name} sits behind the security desk, hitting the side of his monitor.
lobby_guard.description: He's been fighting with the computer all morning, he says, and the computer is winning.

do: "Freeman? You're alive! Get to the surface, I'll hold the door!"
"Hey, Mr. Freeman. The system's down again, so I'll scan you through. Good luck in there today."

lobby_scientist.appearance: {self.Name} paces by the reception desk, looking at a watch.

do: "What have you done? What have we done?"
"Gordon! You're late. The administrator wants the test run before noon. Suit up, quickly."

retinal_scanner.name: retinal scanner
retinal_scanner.description: A wall-mounted retinal scanner, its lens blinking green.

use: A beam sweeps your eye. ACCESS GRANTED, says the panel.

security_desk.name: security desk
security_desk.description: A curved reception desk with a monitor, a phone and a sign-in book.

do: "The spectrometer... it was running hot, I said so! Nobody listens!"
"The spectrometer's running hot, but everything's within tolerance. Probably."

sector_c_scientist.appearance: {self.Name} argues with a colleague about a grant proposal.

microwave.name: microwave

appearance.text: The microwave's door is blown off, and casserole covers the wall.
A microwave hums on the counter, a casserole turning inside.

microwave.description: Somebody's lunch. It has a long way to go.

do: It's beyond help.
You turn the dial all the way up out of sheer curiosity. After a few seconds there is a muffled bang, and casserole paints the inside of the door. A scientist, somewhere, will be very upset.

freeman_locker.name: locker marked FREEMAN
freeman_locker.appearance: Your locker, labelled FREEMAN, stands in the row.
freeman_locker.description: Your locker. Your name. A dent where you once kicked it.

features.name: photo of a cat
features.description: A photo of a cat. You don't remember putting it there.

hev_rack.name: HEV suit rack
hev_rack.appearance: Behind the glass, HEV suits hang on charging frames.
hev_rack.description: Charging frames for HEV suits. One has your size on it.

senior_scientists.name: the senior scientists
senior_scientists.appearance: The two senior scientists bend over their consoles.
senior_scientists.description: One is balding with glasses and a lab coat that's seen better years; the other has a grey beard and a calm voice.

profile.motive_text: understand what is on the other side
profile.backstory: "We've been working toward today for a very long time."

do: "Gordon! We'll go to the surface and find help. You must make it to the Lambda Complex: they'll know what to do. Hurry!"
"Ah, Gordon. The sample is in place. Just push it into the beam when we're ready. Nothing to worry about. Probably."

control_console.name: console
control_console.description: Readouts for the anti-mass spectrometer. The numbers are all slightly higher than anyone would like.

anti_mass_spectrometer.name: anti-mass spectrometer

appearance.text: The spectrometer's emitters are cracked and dead.
The anti-mass spectrometer's beam crackles at the centre of the chamber.

anti_mass_spectrometer.description: A machine for analysing exotic matter, pushed well past its design limits.

sample_cart.name: sample cart

appearance.text: What's left of the sample cart lies twisted against the wall.
The sample cart waits on its rail, a yellowish crystal glowing in its holder.

sample_cart.description: A wheeled cart carrying a crystal sample of unprecedented purity.

do: It's wreckage now.
It's wreckage now.

dead_guard_glock.appearance: The guard who greeted you lies dead behind the desk, his pistol still holstered.

power_junction.name: power junction
power_junction.appearance: A power junction box sits on a catwalk above the water.
power_junction.description: A breaker for this section's power. It's on, and so is the water.

use: You throw the breaker. The sparks in the water die. Safe to wade, now.
push: You throw the breaker. The sparks die.

uc_guard.appearance: {self.Name} crouches behind the desk, pistol up.

office_guard.appearance: {self.Name} has barricaded himself behind a stack of toner boxes.

tripmine.name: laser tripmine
tripmine.appearance: A tripmine's red laser line crosses the shaft.
tripmine.description: Step through the beam and the mine goes off.

do: You shoot the mine. It goes off with a deafening crack, taking a chunk of wall with it.
"They... the tentacles... you have to fire the engine. Fuel, oxygen, power. Get them all running, then fire it from the control room."

appearance.text: The silo power switch is thrown, its lamp green.
A huge power switch for the silo sits in the off position.

do: It's already on.
You haul the switch over. Generators roar into life, and somewhere above, lights come on in the silo.
You haul the switch over. Generators roar into life.
You haul the switch over. Generators roar into life.

appearance.text: The oxygen valve is open; the pumps thrum.
A big red valve wheel controls the oxygen pumps.

do: It's already open.
You spin the wheel. The oxygen pumps start up with a deep thrum.
You spin the wheel. The pumps start up.

appearance.text: The fuel pump controls sit on a gantry, all lights red.

do: They're already running.
You start the fuel pumps. Kerosene surges through the lines toward the silo.
You start the fuel pumps.

engine_fire_button.name: engine test button
engine_fire_button.appearance: A big red button reads ENGINE TEST - FIRE.
engine_fire_button.description: Gauges beside it show fuel, oxygen and power.

powerup_guard.appearance: {self.Name} is pinned behind an overturned rail car.

do: "There's something out there, big as a house, breathes fire. Bullets don't do a thing. If we could get power back to those rails..."

generator_switch.name: generator switch

appearance.text: The generator roars; the rail power indicator glows.
The generator's master switch is in the off position.

generator_switch.description: RAIL POWER, reads the plate. Also: KEEP CLEAR OF TRACKS WHEN ENERGISED.

rail_car.name: rail car
rail_car.appearance: A small maintenance rail car waits on the track.
rail_car.description: Throttle forward, throttle back, a horn. You'll manage.

use: You nudge the throttle. The car hums along a few metres and stops.

launch_console.name: launch console

appearance.text: The launch console reads: LAUNCH SUCCESSFUL.
The launch console blinks: AWAITING AUTHORISATION.

launch_console.description: The controls for the satellite launch.

do: The satellite's already on its way.

do.say: You arm the launch. Far below, the rocket's engines ignite; the whole complex shakes as it climbs out of the silo and away. The scientist whoops: the Lambda team will have their satellite.

do: You hit the launch button. The rocket goes.
"You're Freeman? Thank heaven. We need this satellite in orbit for the Lambda team. Arm the launch from here, then get yourself to the Lambda Complex."

satellite_rocket.name: rocket

appearance.text: The silo is empty and scorched; the rocket is gone.
A slender rocket stands in the silo, ready to launch.

satellite_rocket.description: The payload fairing carries a satellite for the Lambda team.

confiscated_crate.name: crate of confiscated gear
confiscated_crate.appearance: A crate of confiscated gear sits by the ladder.
confiscated_crate.description: Your things, dumped in a box by somebody who expected you to be dead.

qe_scientist.appearance: {self.Name} peers out of an office doorway.

big_laser.name: industrial laser
big_laser.appearance: A huge industrial laser hangs from a gantry.
big_laser.description: It cuts through steel. It would cut through you faster.

osprey_wreck.name: Osprey wreck
osprey_wreck.description: A V-22 tiltrotor, nose crumpled, still burning.

minefield.name: minefield
minefield.description: Walk where the craters are. They've already gone off.

airstrike_radio.name: field radio
airstrike_radio.appearance: A field radio sits on a table in the command tent.
airstrike_radio.description: Tuned to the HECU's artillery net.

lambda_scientist.appearance: {self.Name}, a Lambda team scientist, waves you through the checkpoint.

do: "Freeman! We've been waiting. The satellite delivered its payload; we can open a portal to the border world. But first we need the reactor coolant running."
"Take the module. You'll need it where you're going. The jumps there are... large."

coolant_pump.name: coolant pump
coolant_pump.appearance: A coolant pump control panel sits by the waterline.
coolant_pump.description: PRIMARY COOLANT. Its lamps are red.

do: You start the pump. The water level begins to fall.

teleport_pad.name: teleport pad
teleport_pad.appearance: A teleport pad glows on the floor.
teleport_pad.description: Step on it and you're somewhere else. Which somewhere is the question.

lambda_portal.name: portal
lambda_portal.appearance: The portal churns in the centre of the chamber, showing another world.
lambda_portal.description: Green-white light around a hole in the world. On the other side: Xen.

portal_scientists.name: the Lambda team
portal_scientists.appearance: The Lambda team works frantically at the portal consoles.

do: "The portal is stable. We think. Whatever is holding the rift open is on the other side. You have to find it and stop it. Go, Gordon!"

xen_researcher.name: dead researcher
xen_researcher.appearance: A researcher in an HEV suit lies dead on the rock.
xen_researcher.description: Someone sent through before you. Expeditions, it seems, were not new.

props.text: Survey notes on Xen: low gravity, healing pools, vast fauna. The last page just says THEY KNOW WE'RE HERE.

jump_pad.name: jump pad
jump_pad.appearance: An organic jump pad pulses on the rock.
jump_pad.description: Step on it, and it flings you across the void.

use: You step on the pad. It puffs, and you sail across to the next island and back again. Exhilarating.

healing_crystal.name: healing crystal
healing_crystal.appearance: A golden healing crystal glows on its pillar, feeding the Nihilanth.
healing_crystal.description: While these glow, the Nihilanth heals.

do: You shoot the crystal. It cracks, flares, and goes dark, and the Nihilanth screams.

holo_instructor.name: holographic instructor
holo_instructor.appearance: A flickering hologram of a balding scientist stands here.
holo_instructor.description: He gestures at things you are about to do, with great patience.

talk: The hologram explains, again, how to crouch.

training_target.name: paper target
training_target.appearance: A paper target hangs at the end of the range.

attack: You put a few rounds through the centre ring. The hologram applauds.

profile.motive_text: hold the rift open, and never again be caged
goals: end the last of the humans who came
profile.backstory: Its voice crawls through your skull: "...last of them... you are the last... others came... others die..."
greet: The Nihilanth's voice rolls through your mind: "...Freeman... you come... you will not leave..."
confront: "...you are man... and I am the last..." The words fall apart in your head.

then.say: The healing crystals pulse; the Nihilanth's wounds close. ({self.health}/{self.max_health})

on_death.say: Light pours out of the Nihilanth's split skull. Every portal in the chamber flares, and the world tilts away from under you...

profile.motive_text: see that certain events unfold... according to plan
profile.backstory: He smiles thinly. "Who I am is... not important. What matters is what you do... next."
greet: The man in the suit straightens his tie and regards you with interest.

choice.prompt: "Mister Freeman," the man in the suit says, with that odd rhythm. "You have done... rather well. My employers have authorised me to offer you a job. I'd advise you... to accept. The alternative is... a battle you have no chance of winning."

do.end_game: "Excellent," he says, and straightens his tie. "Time to... choose. I'll see you... up ahead." The world goes dark around you, and you wait for the next job.
"Wise, or not... we shall see." He vanishes. You are standing in a cavern surrounded by alien grunts, every one of them turning toward you.

choice.cancel: He waits. He's very good at waiting.

do: He adjusts his tie and regards you with polite interest. "Not yet, {player.name}. You have... unfinished business. Not... yet." Behind you, a way back opens.
